1. Purpose
Trazys is a gym management application made up of an administration app (ADMIN) and a client app (CLIENT). These terms govern your use of Trazys.

Controller: Roberto Carlos Salvador Martin. NIF: 48910659D. Address: Avenida de Huelva, 6, 21830 Bonares (Huelva), Spain. Contact: Pollinox@hotmail.com.

2. Accounts
You are responsible for keeping your credentials secure and for ensuring that the data you enter is correct.

3. Content you may provide
As a CLIENT you may provide your personal data, your profile photograph and your relationship with the center. Your content is only accessible by your center and by you; it is not published openly.

4. Prohibited content
It is forbidden to enter content that is illegal, offensive, discriminatory, harassing, that infringes the rights of third parties or that does not correspond to the purpose of Trazys.

5. Photographs and data
Your photograph is stored securely in Firebase Storage and is only visible to your center. You may correct or remove your personal data as indicated in the privacy policy.

6. Content removal and reports
You may request the removal of content or report misuse by writing to the contact indicated. Requests are handled manually.

7. Misuse and breach
Misuse may lead to the removal of content, the suspension or deletion of the account, in addition to any applicable legal consequences.

8. Account deletion
You may delete your account from the application (Settings > Delete my account). Doing so deletes your access account, your operational record and the personal data associated with it (profile, photo, bookings, requests, notifications and reports linked to your account). However, certain economic records of the center may be retained for the time necessary to comply with legal, tax or accounting obligations or for the exercise or defence of claims; those records may include your name, surnames and DNI as they appeared at the time of the movement.

9. Limitations and liability
Trazys is provided as is. Your center is responsible for the relationship with you and for the processing of your data in accordance with its own policy.

10. Changes
These terms may be updated. When the current version changes, you must accept the new version to continue using Trazys.

You can also consult the Trazys privacy policy, which is a separate document about the processing of personal data.
1. Data controller

Trazys is an application for managing a center.

Data controller: Roberto Carlos Salvador Martin.
NIF: 48910659D.
Address: Avenida de Huelva, 6, 21830 Bonares (Huelva), Spain.
Privacy and data subject rights contact: Pollinox@hotmail.com.
2. What data we process

When you register or use the application as a client of the center we process the following data:

• Identification data: name, surnames and DNI.
• Contact data: telephone and email address.
• Date of birth (if you provide it).
• Photograph: it is saved in your record and stored securely in the Trazys cloud (Firebase Storage) so that your center can see it.
• Data about your relationship with the center: the business you are linked to, contracted services, sessions and bookings, and the status of your record.
• Economic data of your account with the center: fees and movements, amounts, payment status, payment date and method, and outstanding debt. No card numbers or bank details are stored.
• Cancellation requests and their status.
• Notifications received and your notification preferences.
• Reports: if you report content or a user, or if you are reported, the data necessary to handle the report is processed (user identifier, reason and, where applicable, description).
• Device identifier: it is recorded to manage your account notifications.
• Access account data: email and password (managed by Firebase Authentication) and an internal user identifier.
3. What we use your data for

We use the data to:

• Manage your relationship with the center: registration, contracted services, sessions, bookings and the status of your record.
• Manage the center fees and charges: movements, amounts, status, payment date and method and debt.
• Manage cancellation requests.
• Send you notifications related to your relationship with the center (for example, reminders or notices), if you have authorised them on your device.
• Handle requests and queries and, where applicable, comply with legal obligations.

The application does not use your location: it does not request location permissions or collect your position.
4. Legal basis

We process your data because it is necessary for the service relationship you maintain with the center (for example, managing your registration, your services, your bookings and your payments) and for the legitimate interest of the center in properly managing and administering that relationship.

When we send notifications to your device we process the data with your consent, which you may withdraw at any time by disabling notifications on your device or in the application.

Certain economic data may also be retained due to applicable legal obligations.
5. How data is stored and protected

The data is stored securely in Google cloud services (Firebase) and, in part, on your own device. Communications with the servers are encrypted and access is limited to the person who manages the center and to yourself according to your role. Data is not shared with third parties for advertising.\n\nWhen you delete your account from the application, the identifiable local data stored by the app on your device is also deleted (client identifier, business, pending DNI and associated preferences, as well as local photographs and caches).
6. Service providers

The application uses Google services:

• Firebase Authentication: identification with email and password.
• Firebase (Cloud Firestore): storage of the application data.
• Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM): used to register your device identifier and manage your notifications.
• Firebase Storage: secure storage of your profile photograph and the center logo.

Google may process data outside the European Economic Area. Where necessary, the safeguards provided by data protection regulations will apply, including, where appropriate, standard contractual clauses or other valid mechanisms. No other provider that processes the personal data of users is used.
7. Retention

Personal data will be retained for the time necessary to fulfil the purposes for which it was collected and while a relationship with the user exists, and afterwards for the periods necessary to meet legal obligations and possible liabilities that may arise from the processing.\n\nWhen you delete your account, your access account, your operational record and the associated personal data are deleted. However, the economic history of the center may retain certain records with identifying data (the historical name, surnames and DNI of the movement) for the time necessary to comply with legal, tax or accounting obligations or for the exercise or defence of claims, as applicable.
8. User rights

You may exercise, where applicable, the rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction of processing and portability, as well as withdraw your consent when the processing is based on it. You may also lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es) when you consider it appropriate.
9. How to exercise your rights
You may exercise your rights by writing to Pollinox@hotmail.com, stating your name and the right you wish to exercise. We will handle your request within the legally established periods.
10. Minors

Trazys is not aimed at a specific audience and does not prevent its use by minors merely because they are minors. However, when the processing is based on consent, in Spain a person over 14 years of age is considered able to give their consent; for minors under that age the consent of the holder of parental authority or guardianship will be required. The application does not have a mechanism to verify the age of the user.
11. Changes to the policy
We may update this policy to reflect changes in the application or in the regulations. The current version will always be available in this section.
12. Contact
For any matter related to this policy or to your personal data you can write to: Pollinox@hotmail.com.
